name: Add to Wishlistr
description:
Add items from any webpage to your Wishlistr.

The official Wishlistr button for Edge is the easiest way to add items to your wishlist from any webpage – just click the Wishlistr button next time you find something that you want. 

About Wishlistr:
Wishlistr is an easy to use web-based application that will help you collect, organize and keep track of the things you want. Don't have an account yet? Create your free account on https://wishlistr.com.
